EC1: Decompensated heart failure [OR] or hemodynamic instability
EC2: Prior coronary revascularization  (PCI [OR] or CABG) [OR] or myocardial infarction (as evidenced by previously elevated CPK-MB [OR] or troponin levels)
EC4: Inability to physically tolerate MRI [OR] or implanted objects that are MRI incompatible
EC5: Inability to provide written informed consent obtained at time of study enrollment.
EC7: Advanced heart block [OR] or sinus node dysfunction
EC8: Hypersensitivity [OR] or allergic reaction to regadenoson [OR] or adenosine
EC10: Active bronchospasm [OR] or history of hospitalization [AND] due to bronchospasm
EC13: Use of dipyridamole within the last 5 days
EC15: Severe renal insufficiency [AND] with estimated glomerular filtration rate <30 ml/min/ 1.73 m2
